title: Unit 28 Consolidation: Migration & Identity
goal: Consolidate narrative pacing, gerund periphrases, understatement, concessives, and counterfactual wishes in migration testimony

items: I can pace migration narratives with narrative time connectors, gerund periphrases, and llegar a + infinitive.
I can express persistence across distance with noun-phrase concessives and voice longing with counterfactual wishes.
I can use Unit 28 migration and identity vocabulary accurately in C1 chronicles and dialogue.
